professionalSummary.text: Candidate owns the daily break-handling procedure for card-scheme settlements and maintains the control checklist.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the daily break-handling procedure for Visa and Mastercard settlement files at a regional acquirer, working through the break queue in the reconciliation tool and ticking off the control checklist before the 11:00 treasury cut-off.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate rewrote the reconciliation runbook after the tool migration and trained new analysts on it.
experienceHighlights.witness: Rewrote the reconciliation runbook after the tool migration, adding screenshots for the new break-classification screen, and walked two newly hired analysts through it during their first fortnight.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate documented known limitations and hand-over conditions at each month-end close.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the month-end close notes for the reconciliation queue, listing carried-over breaks, the reason each was open and the analyst taking it over.

skills.text: Candidate coordinates escalations with treasury and merchant services and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Raised unresolved breaks above the agreed threshold to treasury and merchant services through the escalation form; the decision to hold or release a merchant payout stayed with the treasury manager.
